explanation: I searched Mathlib for Gamma0 together with index or primeFactors. Gamma0 appears only in NumberTheory/ModularForms/CongruenceSubgroups.lean and Cusps.lean. Neither file has a result on the index of Gamma0 N; the index lemmas there only cover finite index of conjugated subgroups (finiteIndex_conjGL and related lemmas). The proof rests on the library's own Gamma0_index_eq_prod_factorization plus routine Finsupp/factorization rewriting. Mathlib has no index formula for Γ₀(N).
